note: The tools the build runs that are not Python packages, pinned. scripts/setup.sh installs Quarto from these; a build refuses any other version. Licenses are recorded as each tool states them in its own files.

carries.pandoc: GPL-2.0-or-later. Run by Quarto as a separate program; nothing of it is linked into the build or copied into an article. The page template is the journal's own.
carries.typst: Apache-2.0. Compiles the PDF; its built-in fonts (Libertinus Serif, New Computer Modern, DejaVu Sans Mono) are under the SIL Open Font License and free licenses of their own.

in_every_article.plotly.js: MIT. Carried by the plotly Python package at the version in requirements.lock; written into each page and each one-file copy.
in_every_article.fonts: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Saira, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono); the licenses are in theme/fonts/ and travel into each version's assets/fonts/.

used_at_build_only.Chrome or Chromium: Renders each figure's static picture for kaleido, and runs the browser checks. The one already on the machine is used; none is downloaded.
